## Documentation Location
Link the affected file, section, or page.

## Issue Type
- [ ] Missing documentation
- [ ] Incorrect information
- [ ] Outdated information
- [ ] Unclear instructions
- [ ] Broken link
- [ ] Inconsistent requirements
- [ ] Other

## Problem Description
Describe what is missing, incorrect,
or difficult to understand.

## Current Documentation
Quote or summarize the affected information.

## Expected Documentation
Explain what should be documented instead.

## Affected Area
- [ ] Project Requirements
- [ ] Mechanical Design
- [ ] CAD / Manufacturing
- [ ] Electronics / Wiring
- [ ] Firmware / Software
- [ ] Assembly Instructions
- [ ] Calibration / Testing
- [ ] Other

## Build Variant
- [ ] Printable-frame edition
- [ ] 2020-extrusion edition
- [ ] Imperial reinforcement
- [ ] Metric reinforcement
- [ ] All / Not applicable

## Safety or Reproducibility Impact
Could this documentation problem cause
unsafe operation, incorrect assembly,
or prevent someone from reproducing
the design?

## Suggested Correction
Describe your proposed improvement.

## Supporting Evidence
Link relevant requirements, drawings,
measurements, experiments, or references.

## Verification
How should we verify the correction
is accurate and consistent?
